introHtml: EMT luggage ID tags combine rugged construction with professional branding, making them ideal for first responders, field crews, or corporate travel. These tags withstand frequent handling and exposure, with clear ID windows and secure attachment loops. Choose from leather, molded plastic, or eco-friendly materials, and add your logo or department name via screen printing or debossing. Whether you need tags for safety managers on the go or marketing directors attending trade shows, EMT offers reliable, custom solutions that keep your brand visible and your gear identifiable.
